seo.titel: Ferienwohnung Elias – holiday apartment in Riezlern, Kleinwalsertal
seo.beschreibung: Bright holiday apartment in Riezlern, Kleinwalsertal (Austria): 64 m², 2 bedrooms, quiet location, ski and hiking bus right outside.

start.textSommer: Quietly set at the edge of a meadow, with the bus stop right outside and hiking trails from the door. Our bright apartment is the perfect base for families and friends.
start.textWinter: Ski and hiking bus right outside, a ski boot dryer in the house and a warm, cosy apartment to come back to in the evening.

wohnung.text: Two bedrooms, a living area with kitchen and a private terrace overlooking the greenery. Tap a photo to see it larger.

ausstattung.text: Bed linen and towels are provided – just arrive and feel at home.

punkte: Parking, bike storage, ski boot dryer
